name: Change delivery address
description: Update the delivery address of an order that has not shipped.

slots.name: order_id
slots.prompt: I can update that. Which order ID should I change?
slots.retry_prompt: I need the order ID, for example ORD-1234.

slots.name: address
slots.prompt: What is the full new street address?
slots.retry_prompt: Please give me the new street address, including the number.

slots.name: city
slots.prompt: Which city should it be delivered to?
slots.retry_prompt: Which city is the new address in?

nodes.prompt: Please confirm: send ${slots.order_id} to ${slots.address}, ${slots.city}. Is that right?

nodes.message: Let's start with the address again.
Done. ${slots.order_id} will now be delivered to ${result.address}, ${result.city}.
Is there anything else I can help with?
I could not change the address: ${last_error}.
Let me connect you with an order specialist.
